name: Burgundy Velvet Gold Bees Single Breasted Waistcoat
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in burgundy cotton velvet, embroidered throughout with the house bee in gold thread.

Burgundy cotton velvet, deep in the pile and even throughout, embroidered throughout with the house bee in gold. Six buttons and an adjustable back. Made in England.

This is the most declarative of the bee waistcoats, and it asks for a plain dinner jacket above it and very little else besides. An evening garment rather than a daytime one.

name: Navy Velvet Black Bees Single Breasted Waistcoat
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in navy cotton velvet, embroidered with the house bee in a matching thread rather than gold.

Navy cotton velvet, the pile full and closely laid, embroidered throughout with the house bee in a matching dark thread. Six buttons and an adjustable back. Made in England.

The tonal embroidery is the quieter half of the bee range: the motif declares itself at close range and dissolves into the pile at any distance. The version to choose when the jacket above it is already patterned.

name: Navy Velvet Gold Bees Single Breasted Waistcoat
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in navy cotton velvet, embroidered throughout with the house bee in gold thread.

Navy cotton velvet, with a deep, even pile, embroidered throughout with the house bee in gold. Six buttons and an adjustable back. Made in England.

Navy carries gold rather more warmly than black manages, and the bee is legible without being loud about it. For evening, beneath a navy or midnight dinner jacket.

name: Black Bees Velvet Single Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description: Constructed from 100% cotton velvet, this single-breasted waistcoat in black features our signature Napoleonic bees motif and contrast piping for a statement look that will elevate your sartorial choices this season.

name: Midnight Black Nene Single Breasted Waistcoat
description: A stunning silk and rayon single-breasted waistcoat, this midnight black style with a geometric blue pattern is the perfect option for elegant eveningwear, adding something extra to a tuxedo or dark suit.

name: Rust Mayfair Velvet Single Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in rust Mayfair velvet, piped at the edge, with six buttons and an adjustable back.

Mayfair velvet in rust, the pile deep and evenly laid, piped along the edge in a contrasting binding. Six buttons and an adjustable back. Made in England.

Rust is the most obliging of the autumn colours, keeping company with brown, green and navy without troubling any of them, which makes it useful in a wedding party of several minds. The Rust Mayfair Velvet Wiltshire Gilet and the Rust Mayfair Velvet Artist Jacket are cut from the same cloth.

name: Green Nene Velvet Single Breasted Waistcoat
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in Nene velvet, the motif worked into the pile as small olive batons upon a dark ground.

Nene is a patterned velvet in which the motif is worked into the pile itself, small olive batons set close together on a dark ground. Six mother-of-pearl buttons, welt pockets and an adjustable back. Made in England.

A cloth of this density needs nothing above it but a plain dinner jacket, and does perfectly well on its own with a shirt at a party. The Green Nene Velvet Large Party Bow Tie and the Green Nene Velvet Flat Cummerbund & Bow Tie Set are cut from the same cloth.

name: Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Single Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in burgundy Mayfair velvet, piped at the edge, with six buttons and an adjustable back.

Mayfair velvet in burgundy, deep in the pile and even throughout, piped along the edge in a contrasting binding. Six buttons and an adjustable back. Made in England.

Burgundy velvet is the gentlest introduction to a coloured waistcoat: dark enough for black tie, warm enough for a wedding in January. The Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Nehru Jacket and the Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Newport Jacket with Ticket Pocket are cut from the same cloth.

name: Burgundy Albert Silk 6 Button Single Breasted Waistcoat
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in burgundy damask silk, its pattern held in the weave, with six mother-of-pearl buttons and a lining embroidered with the house bee.

A burgundy damask silk whose pattern lies in the weave rather than the colour, so that the light rather than the dye does the shifting. Six mother-of-pearl buttons, a welt pocket at either side, an adjustable back strap, and a lining embroidered throughout with the house bee. Made in England.

Burgundy answers for those occasions on which black would be a shade too solemn and a true colour a shade too much. It belongs beneath a black or midnight dinner jacket, and at a winter wedding quite as comfortably.

name: Navy Gabardine Single Breasted Waistcoat
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in navy wool gabardine, with six mother of pearl buttons and an adjustable back.

Wool gabardine in navy, a plain cloth with a fine twill face. Single breasted, with six mother of pearl buttons and an adjustable back. Made in England.

Navy asks the least of everything around it and is therefore the waistcoat one reaches for most often: beneath a morning coat at a wedding, and beneath a suit for the remainder of the year. The Ecru/Black Sandleson Wool Cavalry Trouser is cut for the same occasions.

name: Black Albert Silk 6 Button Single Breasted Waistcoat
description:
A single-breasted waistcoat in black damask silk, its pattern held in the weave, with six mother-of-pearl buttons and a lining embroidered with the house bee.

A black damask silk whose pattern lies in the weave rather than the colour, so that the floral emerges only at close quarters. Six mother-of-pearl buttons, a welt pocket at either side, an adjustable back strap, and a lining embroidered throughout with the house bee. Made in England.

Black upon black is the most forgiving way to wear a pattern, which recommends this one equally for black tie and for a wedding in the depths of winter. The Black Hampton Wool Flat Front Dress Trouser completes it.

name: Black Clarendon Double Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description:
A double breasted waistcoat in black Clarendon wool and silk, with a piped shawl lapel, the cloth carrying a small self-coloured dot.

Clarendon is a wool and silk cloth carrying a small self-coloured dot, discernible at conversational range and invisible beyond it. Cut double breasted, with a piped shawl lapel and an adjustable back. Made in England.

The double breasted waistcoat is the more ceremonious of the two shapes, and the one to choose when the evening has been given a name. The Black Clarendon Wool Silk Large Party Bow Tie is cut from the same cloth.

name: Black Windsor Herringbone Wool Morning Coat with trim
description:
An elegant slim-fitting lightweight black morning coat with a herringbone weave, this traditional piece of formal wear is cut away at the front with the tails breaking on the back of the knee. Made from 100% wool, the jacket features peak lapels with a flower loop buttonhole on the left lapel, a four-button working cuff, with a pair of ‘jigger buttons’ on the front and a pair of buttons on the back waist. Inside the jacket is lined with Favourbrook’s signature midnight paisley, with two inside breast pockets and a hidden pocket in the tails.

This coat can be worn with our wedding stripe or houndstooth trousers, a waistcoat, a formal Gatsby or penny collared shirt and tie. Please enquire in-store for a selection of vintage and modern top hats.

name: Sky Blue Culcross Linen Double Breasted Waistcoat
description:
The Favourbrook Textural Blue Linen Double-Breasted Shawl Lapel Waistcoat elevates summer formalwear with effortless sophistication and tactile allure.
Impeccably crafted in a rich, textural pure linen, this waistcoat boasts a light blue hue. The fabric's natural slub and gentle weave deliver a beautifully tactile finish: breathable, slightly crisp, and wonderfully relaxed, yet structured enough to hold a sharp line all day (or night).

Cut in a classic double-breasted silhouette with eight buttons, it features a dramatically sweeping shawl lapel that curves gracefully across the chest, adding a touch of vintage-inspired romance and modern authority. The overlapping fronts create a flattering, cinched effect at the waist, while the adjustable back strap ensures a perfect, tailored fit.
Finished with lustrous smoked pearl buttons—subtly iridescent and cool-toned—they provide quiet contrast against the blue.

name: Pink Monmouth Cotton/Wool Tie
description: The Favourbrook Pink Monmouth Cotton/Wool Tie radiates cheerful sophistication with a refined, contemporary edge, perfect for injecting subtle vibrancy into formal and semi-formal looks. Blended from premium cotton and wool, this tie features a delicate geometric floral pattern: playful blooms distilled into subtle repeating motifs.

name: Black Houndstooth Wool High Waisted Flat Front Trouser
description: For a slimmer-fit trouser, choose one with a flat front. Cut from soft and lightweight Yorkshire wool in a black and cream houndstooth weave, these trousers contrast beautifully with a black morning coat for Ascot or a formal wedding. Our flat-front trousers are high-waisted, with a slim fit leg. Adjustable side tabs at the waist, a zip fly, and buttons for braces provide the finishing touches.

name: Grey Norfolk Herringbone Wool Morning Coat
description: A classic morning coat is synonymous with formal wear. Our Grey Norfolk Herringbone coat is cut from pure wool in a herringbone weave. With a traditional jigger front closure and riding button. Finished with working cuffs, a buttonhole on the lapel, breast pocket, and a secret pocket in the tail of the coat. Wear with our matching herringbone trousers.

name: Grey Norfolk Herringbone High Waisted Flat Front Trousers
description: For a slimmer-fit trouser, choose one with a flat front. Cut from soft and lightweight wool in a grey Norfolk herringbone pattern, these trousers would contrast beautifully with a black morning coat for Ascot or a formal wedding. Our flat-front trousers are high-waisted, with a slim-fit leg. Adjustable side tabs at the waist, a zip fly, and buttons for braces provide the finishing touches.

name: Sky Blue Wolferton Double Breasted Waistcoat
description: Noting says summer sophistication more than our sky blue linen double-breasted waistcoat. Featuring eight mother-of-pearl buttons and two front flap pockets, this shawl lapel waistcoat is ideal to wear with morning dress or relaxed linen suiting.

name: Lilac/White Steed Cotton Gatsby Shirt
description: F. Scott Fitzgerald describes Jay Gatsby as having shirts 'piled like bricks in stacks a dozen high' and writes that, upon seeing his collection, Daisy Buchanan cried because she had never seen such beautiful shirts before. Our Gatsby shirt is worthy of such admiration with its sharp, slim cut, structured formal collar with double button fastening, and French double cuff. This lilac and white formal shirt is a versatile piece that would work well as part of a morning suit for Ascot or a wedding, as well as a business or dinner suit.

name: Pink Stripe/White Henton Cotton Gatsby Shirt
description:
The Pink Stripe/White Henton Cotton Cotton Gatsby Shirt is the epitome of sophistication - a crisp, modern take on the classic dress shirt that exudes quiet confidence and timeless elegance. Crafted from luxurious 100% cotton, this shirt features a refined pink stripe pattern: subtle tonal stripes that add depth and texture. The fabric is lightweight yet structured, offering exceptional breathability and a beautifully soft hand-feel that drapes impeccably under a jacket or waistcoat.

True to Favourbrook's Gatsby signature, the shirt boasts a sharp, slim fit with a structured formal collar, French cuffs, and a concealed button placket. Every detail is meticulously finished, making it a standout choice for morning suits, weddings, Ascot, or refined eveningwear.

name: Blue Stripe/White Steed Cotton Gatsby Shirt
description:
The Blue Stripe/White Steed Cotton Gatsby Shirt is the epitome of sophistication - a crisp, modern take on the classic dress shirt that exudes quiet confidence and timeless elegance.
Crafted from luxurious 100% cotton, this shirt features a refined white-on-blue stripe pattern: subtle tonal stripes that add depth and texture. The fabric is lightweight yet structured, offering exceptional breathability and a beautifully soft hand-feel that drapes impeccably under a jacket or waistcoat.

True to Favourbrook's Gatsby signature, the shirt boasts a sharp, slim fit with a structured formal collar, French cuffs, and a concealed button placket. Every detail is meticulously finished, making it a standout choice for morning suits, weddings, Ascot, or refined eveningwear.

name: White Stripe/White Steed Cotton Gatsby Shirt
description:
The White Stripe/White Steed Cotton Gatsby Shirt is the epitome of sophistication - a crisp, modern take on the classic dress shirt that exudes quiet confidence and timeless elegance.
Crafted from luxurious 100% cotton, this shirt features a refined blue-on-blue stripe pattern: subtle tonal stripes that add depth and texture. The fabric is lightweight yet structured, offering exceptional breathability and a beautifully soft hand-feel that drapes impeccably under a jacket or waistcoat.

True to Favourbrook's Gatsby signature, the shirt boasts a sharp, slim fit with a structured formal collar, French cuffs, and a concealed button placket. Every detail is meticulously finished, making it a standout choice for morning suits, weddings, Ascot, or refined eveningwear.

name: Duck Egg/White Stanfield Cotton Gatsby Shirt
description:
The Duck Egg/White Stanfield Cotton Gatsby Shirt is the epitome of sophistication - a crisp, modern take on the classic dress shirt that exudes quiet confidence and timeless elegance. Crafted from luxurious 100% cotton, this shirt features a matte duck egg blue tone. The fabric is lightweight yet structured, offering exceptional breathability and a beautifully soft hand-feel that drapes impeccably under a jacket or waistcoat.

True to Favourbrook's Gatsby signature, the shirt boasts a sharp, slim fit with a structured formal collar, French cuffs, and a concealed button placket. Every detail is meticulously finished, making it a standout choice for morning suits, weddings, Ascot, or refined eveningwear.

name: Westminster Coat Turk Blue Bower Silk Velvet
description: The Westminster coat is a strikingly modern style with a sleek silhouette to create a flattering feminine shape. It features a grown-on collar, providing a svelte and elegant neckline, with three self covered tab buttoning fastenings to the front and buttoning detail to the back.        Perfect for both day wear and evening looks, this rich and tactile blue silk velvet version is a contemporary classic, featuring delicate Baroque French embroidery.

name: Eton Coat Pourpre Pink Haughley Silk Velvet
description: Our Eton coat is a tailored style that features a re-worked bodice and tailored pockets with back button detailing. Cut from silk and rayon, this sophisticated dusty pink tone is a stunning option for elegant eveningwear, featuring delicate French embroidery rising from the scalloped hem and piping for a clean finish.

name: Swing Jacket Blue Melford Silk Velvet
description: Our ever-popular swing coat is back for another season for the simple reason that we love it! This time around, we have cut the three-quarter length tunic coat in unique blue silk velvet fabric with elegant French embroidery bringing to life a geometric flora pattern for a stunning textural finish. It also features slim tailored sleeves with a working button cuff.

name: Pimlico Coat Pourpre Pink Bower Silk Velvet
description:
The Pimlico Coat is styled on a classic overcoat silhouette with broad peak lapels. Finishing below the knee, this version has been cut from a beautiful pink rayon and silk velvet cloth with French embroidery,

Model is 5'10 with a 34b Bust, 26" waist and 36" hips and wears a Size 10.

Product Composition: 82% Rayon 18% Silk
Manufactured in: London, England

name: Camisole Bias Top Navy Estefania Crepe Satin
description: A most versatile bias-cut camisole, this version can be used in myriad looks, whether as a slinky layer with black tailoring or a casual undergarment. Here we've paired it with matching cigarette trousers for a chic evening look.

name: Camden Jacket Iberian Wine Cotton Velvet
description:
This elegant jacket is based on the classic Nehru shape. Made in London using Favourbrook signature silk velvet, this wine red jacket features a stand collar, fabric covered buttons with working jetted pockets and four-button cuffs.

Model is 5'10 with a 34b Bust, 26" waist and 36" hips wears a Size 10.

Product Composition: 100% Cotton
Manufactured in: London, England

name: Long Swing Coat Claret Plain Cotton Velvet
description: This slim-line Swing coat features a grown-on collar creating a sleek neckline and flattering silhouette. Cut from beautiful claret cotton velvet, this coat is a statement-maker for the winter season and can be worn as both a day piece and an eveningwear layer.

name: Eton Coat Olive Morpeth Silk Velvet
description: Our Eton coat is a tailored style that features a re-worked bodice and tailored pockets with back button detailing. Cut from silk and rayon velvet, this sophisticated olive tone features delicate floral French embroidery and is a stunning option for elegant eveningwear.

name: Black Hampton Wool Double Breasted Dinner Jacket
description: Cut from our Black Hampton wool and finished with a stunning silk satin lapel, this double-breasted dinner jacket is the pinnacle of elegant evening wear. Paired with our dress trousers or wide-leg style, this peerless tuxedo jacket with a black paisley lining and fabric-covered buttons exudes class and confidence.

name: White Canter Cotton Gatsby Shirt
description: Part of the exclusive Royal Ascot collection, our brilliant white Canter Gatsby shirt is a fine iteration of a classic dress shirt, featuring a hidden placket for a minimalist design. Cut from a stunning cotton cloth, it features a well-proportioned pointed collar and French cuffs.

name: Black Dalton Wool Dress Trouser with Trim
description:
The Dalton trouser is the epitome of modern evening elegance. Cut from rich, black pure wool with an exceptionally smooth, high-twist finish, these flat-front trousers sit cleanly at the waist and offer a beautifully controlled, natural taper through the leg. The silhouette is contemporary yet timeless – trim through the thigh, gently tapering to the ankle, creating a long, sleek line that looks exceptionally elegant under dinner jacket or smoking jacket alike.

The defining detail is the lustrous black silk satin side braid (galon) running down each leg – a classic hallmark of the most distinguished evening trousers. The silk catches the light with quiet sophistication, adding subtle drama without ever shouting for attention.

name: Ivory Randwick Linen Double Breasted Dinner Jacket
description: A beautiful rendition of the classic ivory double-breasted tuxedo jacket, this Randwick style has been crafted from a lightweight silk and linen blend for the ultimate luxurious feel and features cloth-covered buttons for a pared-back look brimming with elegance.

name: White Marcella Poplin Cotton Bib Front Dress Shirt
description: A simple, slim fit dress shirt in crisp white Marcella cotton poplin. Featuring a classic bib front panel, structured collar and double cuffs. Finished with a concealed button front, with the comfort of a split yolk across the shoulder. Wear with our Dinner Suit for a complete look.

name: Black Pickwick Silk Bow Tie
description: No sartorial accessory does more to accentuate one’s personal style than the bow tie. This black bow tie is woven from pure silk and adorned with a polka-dot pattern, that's simple yet eye-catching. Slip this around the neck a crisp shirt for formal occasions, and match it with a coordinating pocket square.

name: Black Hampton Wool Flat Front Dress Trouser
description: For on point eveningwear, a sharp pair of dress trousers is essential. Our Hampton Flat Front Dress Trouser is cut from a midweight Yorkshire barathea wool in pitch black. Designed to have a fitted, slim silhouette, these modern tailored trousers have excellent drape but are also highly durable. Finished with traditional grosgrain silk stripes on the outer leg, a zip fly, and brace buttons.

name: Black Hampton Tommy Dinner Jacket
description: Crafted from 100% superfine wool and featuring silk grosgrain notch lapels, this single-breasted Tommy dinner jacket is cut in a modern silhouette with a single-button fastening and two slanted flap pockets. Inside it comes lined in Favourbrook's paisley lining.

name: White Poplin Pleated Pintuck Dress Shirt
description: The White Pleated Dress Shirt features a pleated front panel, designed to be seen when worn under a waistcoat or jacket, while the rest of the shirt is cut from lightweight two fold fine poplin to keep you cool and comfortable. This slim fit shirt is sharply tailored for a modern appearance and has a structured formal collar and French double cuffs for a crisp, clean finish. Our dress shirt is beautifully finished by a concealed button front and benefits from the added comfort and stretch of a split yolk across the shoulders. This formal shirt is perfect to wear with a dinner suit.

name: Black Hampton Tommy Wide-Leg Dress Trouser
description: Part of our new Tommy tuxedo, these black Hampton trousers are cut from a 100% superfine wool cloth and feature a silk satin stripe down the legs. They have a wide-leg silhouette for a very contemporary look, and come with single pleats for a slim yet comfortable fit around the hips.

name: Black Velvet with Black Bees Contrast Large Party Bow Tie
description: No sartorial accessory does more to accentuate one’s personal style than the bow tie. This black velvet bow tie is an elegant flourish, with contrasting gold bees design embroidered on black silk perfect for offsetting a crisp shirt and a traditional dinner jacket.

name: Black Hampton Tommy Dinner Suit
description: Elevate your formal wardrobe with the Black Hampton Tommy Dinner Suit, a sophisticated two-piece ensemble designed for timeless elegance. This classic suit combines a tailored dinner jacket with impeccably cut wide-leg dress trousers, creating a refined silhouette perfect for black-tie events, galas, and formal occasions. Crafted with attention to detail, the jacket features a structured fit and refined lapels, whilst the trousers offer a contemporary wide-leg cut that balances modern style with traditional formal wear. Whether you're attending a wedding, gala, or evening event, this dinner suit delivers the polished, distinguished look that makes a lasting impression.

name: Cream/Black Brooks Spots Silk Large Party Bow Tie
description:
A self-tie party bow in cream silk with black spots set at even intervals, and a butterfly end.

Silk in cream, with black spots set at even intervals. Self-tie, with a butterfly end, cut large for evening. Made in the United Kingdom.

A cream ground carries the bow away from strict black tie and towards a wedding or a party, where the contrast against a dark jacket is the whole idea. The Cream/Black Brooks Spots Silk Tie is cut from the same silk.

name: Cream/Black Brooks Spots Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the Brooks Spots design, black spots set at even intervals on a cream ground. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Brooks Spots design: black spots set at even intervals upon a cream ground. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

The cream ground makes this the lighter half of the spot range, and a wedding tie before it is anything else. Grey and navy suit it, and so does a morning coat. The Cream/Black Brooks Spots Silk Large Party Bow Tie is cut from the same silk.

name: Brown Rosebury Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the brown Rosebury design, a fine spot set at regular intervals on a brown ground. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Rosebury design: a small spot set at regular intervals upon a brown ground. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

Brown is the tie for tweed, corduroy and green, and abandons the wearer entirely the moment it meets black. A corduroy jacket above and a plain shirt beneath.

name: Blue Cranleigh Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the blue Cranleigh design, an outlined lozenge medallion repeated on a mid blue ground. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Cranleigh design: an outlined lozenge medallion repeated upon a mid blue ground. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

For weddings, Royal Ascot and formal daywear. Coordination, not matching, is the object: take one colour from the waistcoat and let the tie carry it. The Navy Gabardine Single Breasted Waistcoat answers particularly well.

name: Rust Rosebury Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the rust Rosebury design, a fine spot set at regular intervals on a rust ground. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Rosebury design: a small spot set at regular intervals upon a rust ground. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

Rust lends the spot a certain warmth without turning it into a statement, which suits an autumn wedding or a day at the races. It does well against green, brown and navy.

name: Grey Cranleigh Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the grey Cranleigh design, an outlined lozenge medallion repeated on a grey ground. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Cranleigh design: an outlined lozenge medallion repeated upon a grey ground. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

Grey is the morning dress colour, and the safest choice at a wedding where one is not the groom. It keeps company with a black or grey morning coat and with almost any waistcoat behind it.

name: Pink Cranleigh Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the pink Cranleigh design, an outlined lozenge medallion repeated on a pink ground. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Cranleigh design: an outlined lozenge medallion repeated upon a pink ground. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

Pink belongs at a wedding or a raceday rather than at a desk, and does better against grey and navy than against black. Take the tone from the buttonhole and not the other way about.

name: Blue Ravenscourt Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the blue Ravenscourt design, a geometric fret worked in blue, black and cream. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Ravenscourt design: a geometric fret repeated in blue, black and cream. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

A geometric of this scale asks for a plain waistcoat above it, and rewards a pocket square drawn from one of its quieter colours. Coordination, not matching, is the object.

name: Rust Ravenscourt Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the rust Ravenscourt design, a geometric fret worked in rust and cream. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Ravenscourt design: a geometric fret repeated in rust and cream. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

Rust is an autumn colour and keeps to brown, green and caramel rather than black. It does well against the Brown Witham Corduroy Cooper Jacket and against any of the rust velvets.

name: Blue Rosebury Silk Tie
description:
A silk tie in the blue Rosebury design, a fine white spot set at regular intervals on a blue ground. Made in Italy.

Silk, made in Italy, in the Rosebury design: a small white spot set at regular intervals upon a blue ground. The blade measures 8cm and the tie 154cm.

The spot is the most companionable of all tie patterns, which is why a drawer without one is incomplete. It answers at a wedding, at the races and on an ordinary Tuesday, and is small enough to sit behind a patterned waistcoat without quarrel.

name: Navy Starling Silk Scarf
description:
A silk scarf in navy with a cream spot, finished with fringed ends. Made in Italy.

Silk in navy, patterned with a cream spot along its length and finished with a fringe at either end. Made in Italy.

A silk scarf is the evening one, sitting flat beneath a dinner jacket collar where a wool scarf would bunch. Navy with a spot is the most useful of them, dark enough for black tie and light enough for a coat by day.

name: Caramel Britford Corduroy Cooper Jacket
description:
A Cooper jacket in caramel Britford corduroy, a broad wale cotton cord with a deep nap.

Cut in Britford, a broad wale cotton corduroy in caramel, the ribs wide enough to catch the light along their length so that the colour shifts as one moves. Made in Portugal.

A broad wale is a country cloth before it is anything else, and caramel is the warmest of the three colourways offered. The Caramel Britford Corduroy Cooper Trouser is cut from the same cord and makes the suit.

name: Caramel Britford Corduroy Cooper Trouser
description:
Trousers in caramel Britford corduroy, a broad wale cotton cord with a deep nap.

Caramel Britford, a broad wale cotton corduroy, the ribs running the length of the leg. Made in Portugal.

Broad wale cord takes a crease less obligingly than wool, which is rather what one wants of it at the weekend. The Caramel Britford Corduroy Cooper Jacket makes the suit. A velvet jacket in green or navy breaks it, which is more often the better answer.

name: White Poplin Cotton Gatsby Shirt
description: F. Scott Fitzgerald describes Jay Gatsby as having shirts 'piled like bricks in stacks a dozen high' and writes that, upon seeing his collection, Daisy Buchanon cried because she had never seen such beautiful shirts before. Our Gatsby shirt is worthy of such admiration with its sharp, slim cut, structured formal collar with double button fastening, and French double cuff. Crafted from two fold fine quality poplin, this lightweight cloth is beautifully finished by a concealed button front and benefits from the added comfort and stretch of a split yolk across the shoulders. This formal shirt is a versatile piece that would work well as part of a morning suit for Ascot or a wedding, as well as a business or dinner suit.

name: Green Nene Dinner Jacket
description:
A dinner jacket in Nene velvet, the motif worked into the pile as small olive batons upon a dark ground, with a plain contrast-faced lapel.

Nene is a patterned velvet in which the motif is worked into the pile itself, small olive batons set close together on a dark ground. The lapel is faced in a plain dark cloth, so that the pattern stops obligingly at the edge. Made in Portugal.

A patterned dinner jacket is permitted a certain latitude provided everything else is beyond reproach: a plain shirt, a black bow and plain trousers. The Green Nene Velvet Large Party Bow Tie and the Green Nene Velvet Flat Cummerbund & Bow Tie Set are cut from the same cloth.

name: Ivory Poplin Cotton Pleated Pintuck Dress Shirt
description: A lightweight, slim fit, formal shirt featuring a cutaway collar, double cuff and a concealed button front. A split yolk adds comfort across the shoulders. Wear with a Dinner Suit for a tailored and modern look.

name: Black Clarendon Wool Silk Large Party Bow Tie
description:
A self-tie party bow in black Clarendon wool and silk, with a butterfly end and the same fine self-coloured dot as the dinner jacket.

Wool and silk in black, carrying a small self-coloured dot. Self-tie, with a butterfly end, cut large for evening and not for day. Made in the United Kingdom.

Cut from the same cloth as the Black Clarendon Shawl Lapel Dinner Jacket, so the two may be worn together, or set against a plain black dinner jacket where the dot supplies the only interest.

name: Olive Velvet Gold Bees Single Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description: Constructed from 100% cotton velvet, this single-breasted waistcoat in olive features our signature Napoleonic bees motif and piping for a statement look that will elevate your sartorial choices this season.

name: Green Britford Corduroy Cooper Suit
description: The Green Britford Corduroy Cooper Suit combines refined British tailoring with distinctive texture. Crafted in rich green corduroy, this suit features the precision construction and clean lines that define contemporary formalwear. The Cooper cut delivers a modern silhouette suited to formal occasions and elevated everyday wear. Finished with careful attention to lapels, button placement, and seaming, it pairs seamlessly with dress shirts, ties, and accessories for a polished, confident appearance.

name: Caramel Britford Corduroy Cooper Suit
description: The Caramel Britford Corduroy Cooper Suit combines refined British tailoring with distinctive texture. Crafted in warm caramel corduroy, this suit features the precision construction and clean lines that define contemporary formalwear. The Cooper cut delivers a modern silhouette suited to formal occasions and elevated everyday wear. Finished with careful attention to lapels, button placement, and seaming, it pairs seamlessly with dress shirts, ties, and accessories for a polished, confident appearance.

name: Grey Dunster Flannel Wool Cooper Suit
description:
The Grey Dunster Wool Cooper Suit is a beautiful iteration of Favourbrook’s tailoring principles, merging a heritage aesthetic with a contemporary edge. Expertly crafted from a soft flannel wool, this ensemble is defined by its wonderfully textural handle, offering refined depth and tactile warmth perfect for the cooler months.

The jacket is built on our Cooper house block, featuring a classic silhouette that is gently waisted for a flattering, structured look. Broad notch lapels lend a generous, contemporary formality, while the clean two-button closure and two slanted waist pockets accentuate its sharp, elongated lines. Every detail reflects meticulous craftsmanship, ensuring a sophisticated balance of comfort and sartorial precision.

Completing the suit, these beautifully tailored Dunster Dress Trousers are designed for versatility, whether worn as part of the full ensemble or as sophisticated separates. Cut from the same soft textural flannel, they feature single pleats for a slim yet comfortable fit around the hips and side button adjusters to ensure a clean, belt-free waist. The result is a smart, polished silhouette that maintains classic proportions with a modern, textural finish.

name: Stone Hembridge Linen Cooper Suit
description:
The Favourbrook Stone Hembridge Linen Unlined Cooper Suit is the quintessential summer ensemble, epitomising British elegance in a soft sand tone. Expertly crafted from premium linen, chosen for its superior, breathable weave, natural texture, lightness, and cooling properties, the unlined jacket features broad notch lapels, while the two-button closure provides a clean, versatile silhouette. Two front pockets cut on the bias add subtle dynamic flair, and the four-button working cuffs showcase Favourbrook's hallmark artisanal detail.

It comes with our matching Cooper trouser, featuring a single pleat front for comfort and a gentle break in the line, side adjusters for a clean, belt-free waist, and a naturally tapered leg that slims elegantly from hip to hem, creating a smart, elongated silhouette with contemporary polish while maintaining classic proportions.

name: Beige Ludbrook Wool Newport Suit
description:
The Favourbrook Beige Ludbrook Wool Newport Suit exemplifies our signature house style, offering refined versatility and impeccable British tailoring for business, semi-formal events, or sophisticated everyday wear.

Crafted from pure 100% wool in a sophisticated beige shade, this jacket delivers a soft hand-feel, excellent drape, and year-round wearability with subtle texture and understated elegance. As the quintessential Newport silhouette - Favourbrook's iconic house cut - it features perfectly proportioned peak lapels that add a touch of sharp formality, a streamlined single-button closure for a clean, modern line, and four-button working cuffs that highlight artisanal craftsmanship.

It comes with sleek flat-fronted trousers with a natural taper running through the leg and a button pocket at the rear.

name: Sage Green Hembridge Linen Cooper Suit
description:
The Favourbrook Sage Green Hembridge Linen Unlined Cooper Suit is the quintessential summer ensemble, epitomising British elegance in a soft green tone. Expertly crafted from premium linen, chosen for its superior, breathable weave, natural texture, lightness, and cooling properties, the unlined jacket features broad notch lapels, while the two-button closure provides a clean, versatile silhouette. Two front pockets cut on the bias add subtle dynamic flair, and the four-button working cuffs showcase Favourbrook's hallmark artisanal detail. 

It comes with our matching Cooper trouser, featuring a single pleat front for comfort and a gentle break in the line, side adjusters for a clean, belt-free waist, and a naturally tapered leg that slims elegantly from hip to hem, creating a smart, elongated silhouette with contemporary polish while maintaining classic proportions.

name: Pink Camberley Linen Cooper Suit
description:
The Pink Camberley Linen Cooper Suit captures effortless British sophistication with a contemporary edge, radiating a soft, seasonal charm perfect for destination weddings, garden parties, or refined al fresco dining. Tailored in a premium Camberley linen for superior breathability and a rich natural weave, this unlined construction delivers exceptional lightness and a relaxed drape without compromising on tailored sophistication.

The jacket features broad notch lapels for a generous, contemporary formality, paired with a clean two-button closure that flatters a range of builds. Meticulous artisanal details include two front pockets cut on the bias for a subtle dynamic flair and four-button working cuffs, hallmarks of Favourbrook’s peerless craftsmanship.

Completing the ensemble, the Cooper Linen Trouser delivers refined texture and impeccable harmony. These trousers feature a single pleat front for added comfort and a gentle break in the line, while side adjusters ensure a clean, belt-free waist. The naturally tapered leg slims elegantly from hip to hem, creating a smart, elongated silhouette with contemporary polish while maintaining classic proportions.

name: Olive Parker Wool Newport Suit
description:
The Olive Parker Wool Newport Suit captures a sophisticated expression of British tailoring, combining a rich seasonal palette with refined distinction. Expertly crafted from premium wool in a deep, earthy olive shade, this ensemble delivers luxurious texture, natural warmth, and a flawless drape, making it an ideal choice for year-round formal versatility.

The jacket is built on the iconic Newport house block, featuring sharp peak lapels for a touch of dramatic flair and a clean single-button closure designed to elongate the silhouette. Its construction includes lightly padded shoulders for subtle definition, a welted breast pocket, slanted flap pockets, and four-button working cuffs, all hallmarks of Favourbrook’s peerless craftsmanship.

The suit is completed by the Parker Dress Trouser, a refined essential that provides sophisticated depth and excellent structure. These trousers offer a comfortable, natural drape and a clean finish that complements the jacket's sharp lines, creating a cohesive, smart silhouette that balances unique character with timeless elegance.

name: Slate Grey Dalton Wool Newport Suit
description:
The Favourbrook Slate Grey Dalton Wool Newport Jacket exemplifies our signature house style, offering refined versatility and impeccable British tailoring for business, semi-formal events, or sophisticated everyday wear.

Crafted from pure wool with a hint of elastane for additional comfort in a sophisticated slate grey shade, this jacket delivers a soft hand-feel, excellent drape, and year-round wearability with subtle texture and understated elegance. As the quintessential Newport silhouette - Favourbrook's iconic house cut - it features perfectly proportioned peak lapels that add a touch of sharp formality, a streamlined single-button closure for a clean, modern line, and four-button working cuffs that highlight artisanal craftsmanship. 

It comes with flat-front trousers that sit cleanly at the waist and offer a beautifully controlled, natural taper through the leg.

name: Black Hampton Wool Dinner Suit
description:
The Black Hampton Wool Newport Dinner Suit captures the essence of on-point eveningwear, merging sharp British tailoring with a contemporary edge. Expertly crafted from midweight Yorkshire barathea wool in a deep pitch black, this ensemble delivers exceptional durability and a luxurious drape that holds its shape beautifully throughout the most distinguished occasions.

The jacket features an elegant slim-fitting, single-breasted silhouette. It is defined by sharp grosgrain silk peak lapels and matching silk-covered buttons for a touch of dramatic flair. Hallmarks of Favourbrook’s peerless craftsmanship are present in every detail: a welted breast pocket, slanted flap pockets, and four-button working cuffs. Inside, the jacket reveals a signature touch of character with a Favourbrook midnight paisley lining and three functional internal pockets.

The suit is completed by the Hampton Flat Front Dress Trouser, a refined essential cut to a modern, slim silhouette. These trousers feature traditional grosgrain silk stripes on the outer leg to perfectly mirror the jacket’s lapels, alongside a zip fly and brace buttons for a secure, tailored fit. The result is a smart, elongated silhouette that balances timeless formal proportions with a sleek, polished aesthetic.

name: Black Bees Velvet Newport Suit
description: The Black Bees Velvet Newport Suit combines sophisticated tailoring with luxurious texture. Crafted from sumptuous velvet, this suit delivers a distinctive aesthetic perfect for elevated occasions and statement-making moments. The Newport cut ensures a refined silhouette with impeccable structure, while the rich black velvet adds depth and visual interest. Ideal for formal events, evening wear, or those seeking to stand out with confidence and style.

name: Millie Panel Dress Navy Ochre Astwell Silk Devore Chiffon
description: The Millie Panel dress is a new shape for this season, featuring a longer line fit-and-flare skirt and a flattering empire line detail with a deep v-neck. A softly tailored panel skirt and flattering three quarter length sleeves make this dress both elegant and practical. Finished with a pretty tulip sleeve detail and a concealed zip fastening.

name: Camisole Dress Black Heavy Crepe Satin
description: This slinky long-line camisole dress is a very versatile eveningwear option, cut from heavy crepe satin. It can be worn on its own with a dark blazer or cropped jacket for a sophisticated and sexy look.

name: Camisole Dress Emerald Saona Crepe Satin
description:
This slinky long-line camisole dress in emerald is a very versatile eveningwear option, cut from heavy crepe satin. It can be worn on its own or with a linen coat for a sophisticated look.

Model is 5'10 with a 34b Bust, 26" waist and 36" hips and wears a Size 10

Product Composition: 100%PL
Manufactured in: London, England

name: Serena Longer Circle Dress Ox Blood Plain Georgette
description: This classic scoop neck dress is expertly cut from luxurious silk georgette. Featuring a full circle skirt with a satin belt and three-quarter length sleeves, it is finished with a concealed zip fastening.

name: Serena Circle Dress Moss Plain Georgette
description: This classic scoop neck dress is expertly cut from luxurious silk georgette. Featuring a full circle skirt, with a satin belt and three quarter length sleeves. Finished with a concealed zip fastening.

name: Serena Circle Dress Black Georgette Silk Georgette
description: Our perennial favourite, the Serena Circle dress features a scoop neck, three-quarter sleeves, and a satin belt with bow detail, with a flirty circle skirt. Effortlessly feminine and undeniably flattering.

name: Serena Circle Dress Midnight Silk Georgette
description: Our perennial favourite, the Serena Circle dress features a scoop neck, three-quarter sheer sleeves, and a satin belt with bow detail, with a flirty circle skirt. Effortlessly feminine and undeniably flattering, this midnight tone in silk georgette is effortlessly chic both day and night.

name: Serena Circle Dress Berry Georgette Silk Georgette
description: Our perennial favourite, the Serena Circle dress features a scoop neck, three-quarter sleeves, and a satin belt with bow detail, with a flirty circle skirt. Effortlessly feminine and undeniably flattering.

name: Serena Circle Dress Grey Glacier Plain Silk Georgette
description: This classic scoop neck dress is expertly cut from luxurious silk georgette. Featuring a full-circle skirt, with a satin belt and three-quarter-length sleeves, it is finished with a concealed zip fastening.

name: Bella Dress Burgundy plum Silk Satin
description:
This softly shaped v-neck shift dress is a new style this season, and features both a gathered shoulder detail and a pretty fluted sleeve finish. A concealed zip fastening adds to its refined minimalism.

Model is 5'10 with a 34b Bust, 26" waist and 36" hips and wears a Size 10.



Product Composition: 100% Silk
Manufactured in: London, England

name: Josephine Dress Antique Rose Reverse Plain Silk Shantung
description:
This solid colour silk day dress in antique rose by Favourbrook is woven in Italy using a stunning silk Shantung cloth. Featuring a silk organza 3/4 sleeve, back vent and concealed zip fastening, it is a very elegant eveningwear option this season.

Model is 5'10 with a 34b bust, 26" waist and 36" hips and wears a Size 10.

Product Composition: 100% Silk
Manufactured in: London, England

name: Josephine Dress Plum Varnasi Silk Douppion
description: This plum-tone silk douppion Josephine dress features a tulip cap sleeve, back vent, and concealed zip fastening, With a subtle textural quality, it's an effortlessly elegant silhouette that can be easily dressed up or down, for day or evening.

name: Burgundy Velvet Double Breasted Smoking Jacket
description: This traditional burgundy velvet smoking jacket is double breasted with a contrasting black velvet shawl lapel edged with black braid and black velvet covered buttons. The jacket features two rows of black frogging and a loop of braid on the sleeves, it is finished with a welted breast pocket, two jetted side pockets. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook's midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Navy Velvet Double Breasted Smoking Jacket
description: This traditional navy velvet smoking jacket is double breasted with a contrasting black velvet shawl lapel edged with black braid and black velvet covered buttons. The jacket features two rows of black frogging and a loop of braid on the sleeves, it is finished with a welted breast pocket, two jetted side pockets. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook's midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Sapphire Blue Velvet Double Breasted Smoking Jacket
description: This traditional sapphire blue velvet smoking jacket is double breasted with a contrasting black velvet shawl lapel edged with black braid and black velvet covered buttons. The jacket features two rows of black frogging and a loop of braid on the sleeves, it is finished with a welted breast pocket, two jetted side pockets. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook's midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Bottle Green Velvet Double Breasted Smoking Jacket
description: This traditional bottle green velvet smoking jacket is double breasted with a contrasting black velvet shawl lapel edged with black braid and black velvet covered buttons. The jacket features two rows of black frogging and a loop of braid on the sleeves, it is finished with a welted breast pocket, two jetted side pockets. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook's midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Racing Green Velvet Double Breasted Smoking Jacket
description:
This traditional green velvet smoking jacket is double breasted with a contrasting black velvet shawl lapel edged with black braid and black velvet covered buttons. The jacket features two rows of black frogging and a loop of braid on the sleeves, it is finished with a welted breast pocket, two jetted side pockets. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook's midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

Wear this smoking jacket with Favourbrook's black Hampton dress trousers, a white pleated dress shirt and silk bow tie.

name: Sapphire Blue Velvet Single Breasted Grosvenor Smoking Jacket
description: An elegant slim-fitting single-breasted smoking jacket, this sapphire blue version is the pinnacle of eveningwear sophistication. The black velvet shawl lapel is edged with braid, which matches the traditional black frogging detail at the waist, and contrasts against the claret velvet. The jacket features a welted breast pocket and slanted flapped side pockets and four button working cuffs. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Bottle Green Velvet Single Breasted Grosvenor Smoking Jacket
description: An elegant slim-fitting single-breasted smoking jacket, this bottle green version is the pinnacle of eveningwear sophistication. The black velvet shawl lapel is edged with braid, which matches the traditional black frogging detail at the waist, and contrasts against the claret velvet. The jacket features a welted breast pocket and slanted flapped side pockets and four button working cuffs. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Claret Velvet Single Breasted Grosvenor Smoking Jacket
description: An elegant slim-fitting single-breasted smoking jacket, this claret version is the pinnacle of eveningwear sophistication. The black velvet shawl lapel is edged with braid, which matches the traditional black frogging detail at the waist, and contrasts against the claret velvet. The jacket features a welted breast pocket and slanted flapped side pockets and four button working cuffs. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Navy Velvet Single Breasted Grosvenor Smoking Jacket
description: An elegant slim fitting single breasted smoking jacket. The black velvet shawl lapel is edged with braid, which matches the traditional black frogging detail at the waist, and contrasts against the navy velvet. The jacket features a welted breast pocket and slanted flapped side pockets and four button working cuffs. Inside, the jacket is lined in Favourbrook midnight paisley with three internal pockets.

name: Olive Velvet Single Breasted Grosvenor Smoking Jacket
description: A versatile piece that can take you from cocktails, to dinner, to the club, the Olive Velvet Grosvenor Jacket is elegant eveningwear, perfect for parties or lounging. Cut to a fitted slim silhouette from luxurious velvet in dark midnight, this tailored jacket has excellent drape and a tactile finish. Classic details including a black velvet shawl lapel, black velvet buttons on the working cuffs and traditional frogging details on the single button closure add the final touches. Featuring considered pocket placement, with a welted breast pocket, slanted flapped side pockets, and three internal pockets.

name: Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Single Breasted Smoking Jacket
description:
A single breasted smoking jacket in burgundy cotton velvet, with a braided shawl lapel, angled jet pockets and black frogging at the fastening.

Burgundy cotton velvet, with a deep, even pile. Single breasted, with a shawl lapel finished in braid, angled jet pockets beneath flaps, and black frogging at the fastening. Made in Portugal.

Braid and frogging are what distinguish a smoking jacket from a dinner jacket, which relies instead upon silk facings. It answers an invitation asking for black tie with some licence, and suits an evening at which a dinner jacket would seem rather too much in earnest.

name: Olive Mayfair Velvet Single Breasted Smoking Jacket
description:
A single breasted smoking jacket in olive Mayfair velvet, with a braided shawl lapel, angled jet pockets and black frogging at the fastening.

Olive cotton velvet, the pile full and closely laid. Single breasted, with a shawl lapel finished in braid, angled jet pockets beneath flaps, and black frogging at the fastening. Made in Portugal.

Olive is the smoking jacket for the man who already owns a black one. Under lamplight it goes very nearly to black, and recovers its green the moment daylight is admitted, which suits an evening beginning before dusk.

name: Blue Scarsdale Velvet Nehru Jacket
description:
Part of an exclusive capsule in collaboration with Eddie Sahakian of Davidoff of St James's, this Nehru jacket is cut from Scarsdale Blue cotton velvet fabric finished with brass buttons and jetted pockets. The print is an original floral developed with an Italian mill, worked in blue and aquamarine and faded in the manner of old indigo. Cut with a standing collar. Made in the United Kingdom.

With no lapels and no tie needed, it suits an evening when a dinner jacket would be more than the invitation asks. The same cloth makes the dinner jacket with a cigar pocket and a single-breasted waistcoat. Read A Jacket for the Cigar Hour in the Journal.

name: Blue Scarsdale Velvet Dinner Jacket with Cigar Pocket
description:
Part of an exclusive capsule in collaboration with Eddie Sahakian of Davidoff of St James's: a dinner jacket designed specifically for the cigar smoker. The result is a modern take on eveningwear that feels both celebratory and rebellious.

Scarsdale Blue is a cotton velvet printed with an original floral, developed with an Italian mill, in subdued blue and aquamarine with the faded look of old indigo. Cut as a single-breasted dinner jacket with one button, it has black silk peak lapels cut wider than usual, at 10 cm, and silk-covered buttons. Inside, a pocket is sized for a cigar, and a pocket for the cutter is set inside the outside pocket. The lining carries the house bee. Made in Portugal.

Eddie, whose family has run Davidoff of St James's since his father, Edward, opened it in 1980, wanted something other than the classic shawl-collar smoking jacket, with the colour and sense of occasion Favourbrook is known for. Silk-faced lapels, in place of braid and frogging, make it a dinner jacket, though it was made with the cigar in mind. The same cloth is cut as a Nehru jacket and a single-breasted waistcoat. Read A Jacket for the Cigar Hour in the Journal.

name: Navy Mayfair Velvet Shawl Dinner Jacket
description:
A single breasted dinner jacket in navy Mayfair velvet, with a shawl lapel and slanted flap pockets.

Navy cotton velvet, deep in the pile and even throughout. Single breasted, with a shawl lapel, slanted flap pockets and a double vent. Made in Portugal.

Navy velvet under lamplight goes deeper than black ever does, which is the whole argument for owning it. The shawl lapel is the gentler of the two proper to a dinner jacket. The Black Hampton Wool Flat Front Dress Trouser completes it.

name: Rust Mayfair Velvet Newport Jacket with Ticket Pocket
description:
A one-button Newport jacket in rust Mayfair velvet, with a peak lapel, angled jet pockets and a ticket pocket.

Rust cotton velvet, the pile deep and evenly laid. One button, a peak lapel, angled jet pockets beneath flaps, a ticket pocket and buttoned cuffs. Made in Portugal.

A peak lapel gives a sharper line than either shawl or notch, and the single button keeps the front long and uninterrupted. Rust suits an autumn evening a good deal better than black does.

name: Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Newport Jacket with Ticket Pocket
description:
A one-button Newport jacket in burgundy Mayfair velvet, with a peak lapel, angled jet pockets and a ticket pocket.

Burgundy cotton velvet, the pile full and closely laid. One button, a peak lapel, angled jet pockets beneath flaps, a ticket pocket and buttoned cuffs. Made in Portugal.

The peak lapel and the single button carry the Newport nearer to evening dress than the Artist jacket ever gets, while stopping short of the silk facings that would make it a dinner jacket. The Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Single Breasted Waistcoat with Piping and the Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Nehru Jacket are cut from the same cloth.

name: Green Nene Velvet Nehru Jacket
description:
A Nehru jacket in Nene velvet, the motif worked into the pile as small olive batons upon a dark ground, with a standing collar.

Nene is a patterned velvet in which the motif is worked into the pile itself, small olive batons set close together on a dark ground. Cut as a classic Nehru with a standing collar, antique brass buttons and three jet pockets. Made in England.

A standing collar suits a busy cloth better than a lapel, there being no notch or peak to argue with the pattern. The Black Hampton Wool Flat Front Dress Trouser below it.

name: Navy Velvet Black Bees Nehru Jacket
description:
A Nehru jacket in navy cotton velvet, embroidered with the house bee in a matching thread, with a standing collar and antique brass buttons.

Navy cotton velvet embroidered throughout with the house bee in a matching dark thread, cut as a classic Nehru with a standing collar. Antique brass buttons, three jet pockets and a button cuff. Made in England.

Tonal embroidery is the civilised way to put a pattern on a jacket: legible at close range, and content to be texture from any further off. The Navy Velvet Black Bees Single Breasted Waistcoat and the Navy Velvet Black Bees Wiltshire Gilet are cut from the same cloth.

name: Navy Mayfair Velvet Nehru Jacket
description:
A Nehru jacket in navy Mayfair velvet, with a standing collar, antique brass buttons and three jet pockets.

Navy cotton velvet, the pile full and closely laid, cut as a classic Nehru with a standing collar. Antique brass buttons, three jet pockets and a button cuff. Made in England.

Navy is the version to begin with, being the least theatrical and the most useful. Worn without a tie it answers an evening invitation that gave no instructions, and passes for tailoring rather than fancy dress.

name: Burgundy Mayfair Velvet Nehru Jacket
description:
A Nehru jacket in burgundy Mayfair velvet, with a standing collar, antique brass buttons and three jet pockets.

Burgundy cotton velvet, with a deep, even pile, cut as a classic Nehru with a standing collar. Antique brass buttons, three jet pockets and a button cuff. Made in England.

Dispensing with both lapel and tie, the Nehru is the jacket for an evening whose invitation declined to specify. Dressed enough for dinner, and worn without a tie.

name: Rust Mayfair Velvet Artist Jacket
description:
An Artist jacket in rust Mayfair velvet, with smoked pearl buttons, exposed patch pockets and a breast pocket.

Rust cotton velvet, with a deep, even pile. Smoked pearl buttons, exposed patch pockets and a breast pocket. Made in England.

Rust is the autumn colour of the velvet range, and looks a great deal better against brown and green than against black. Cut without the structure of a dinner jacket, it wears closer to a shirt than to tailoring.

name: Black Windsor Herringbone Wool Morning Coat
description:
An elegant slim-fitting lightweight black morning coat with a herringbone weave, this traditional piece of formal wear is cut away at the front with the tails breaking on the back of the knee. Made from 100% wool woven in Yorkshire, the jacket features peak lapels with a flower loop buttonhole on the left lapel, a four-button working cuff, with a pair of ‘jigger buttons’ on the front and a pair of buttons on the back waist. Inside the jacket is lined with Favourbrook’s signature midnight paisley, with two inside breast pockets and a hidden pocket in the tails.

This coat can be worn with our wedding stripe or houndstooth trousers, a waistcoat, a formal Gatsby or penny collared shirt and tie. Please enquire in-store for a selection of vintage and modern top hats.

name: Yellow Gabardine Wool Double Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description: A classic , double breasted waistcoat is imbued with the history of formalwear. Usually worn at Ascot, and at formal weddings with a tie and a morning coat , but it can look fantastic with a suit or a tweed jacket for all gents who like to be dapper despite having decided to ditch a morning coat itself. Gabardine wool is light, yet long lasting. This soft yellow shade is timeless, classic and versatile. A refreshing change to a grey or beige colour.

name: White Poplin Cotton Wedding Shirt
description: Specifically designed for one's big day, our white poplin wedding shirt is an immaculate expression of sartorial excellent. Featuring French cuffs and a double placket, the spread collar perfectly frames the face. Ideal to wear with morning dress or elegant suiting.

name: Royal Ascot Stripe Trouser
description: Traditional high-waisted, flat-fronted trouser. The Royal Ascot stripe trousers are designed to be worn with the black Chesham morning coat. These trousers are made from 100% wool in a sophisticated charcoal stripe and feature side adjusters, slanted hip pockets, and a single rear hip pocket, brace buttons and a zip fly. These trousers are half lined for comfort.

name: Navy Ascot Wool Morning Coat
description: An elegant slim-fitting lightweight navy morning coat made exclusively for the Royal Ascot collection, but also perfect for weddings, this traditional piece of formal wear is cut away at the front with the tails breaking on the back of the knee. Crafted from 100% silk, the jacket features peak lapels with a flower loop buttonhole on the left lapel, four button working cuffs with a pair of 'jigger buttons' at the front waist, and a second pair on the back waist. Inside the jacket is finished with Favourbrook's signature midnight paisley lining with two in breast pockets and a hidden pocket in the tail.

name: Navy Ascot High Waisted Flat Front Trouser
description: Designed to be worn with our Ascot navy silk morning suit, these 100% silk dress trousers are the ultimate in formal luxury. Perfect for weddings and Royal Ascot, they are one half of a most exquisite representation of modern formalwear, featuring a high-waisted cut in a flat-front style.

name: Sand Randwick Double Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description: Noting says summer sophistication more than our sand-coloured Randwick linen double-breasted waistcoat. Featuring eight mother-of-pearl buttons and two front flap pockets, with subtle tonal piping to accentuate the lines, this shawl lapel waistcoat is ideal to wear with morning dress or relaxed linen suiting.

name: Sky Blue Randwick Double Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description: Crafted from a silk and linen blend, this eight-button double-breasted shawl lapel waistcoat in sky blue highlights the stunning textural qualities of these magnificent fabrics. The sky blue tone is wonderfully versatile, pairing well with cream tones, neutrals, and other pastels.

name: Lilac Randwick Double Breasted Waistcoat
description: With sweeping shawl lapels and a double-breasted 8-button silhouette, this stunning lilac waistcoat has been crafted from a lightweight silk and linen fabric for the most opulent finish, perfect with morning dress or summer tailoring.

name: Sage Green Randwick Double Breasted Waistcoat with Piping
description: Crafted from a silk and linen blend, this eight-button double-breasted shawl lapel waistcoat in sage green highlights the stunning textural qualities of these magnificent fabrics. The sage green tone is wonderfully versatile, pairing well with cream tones, neutrals, and other earthy hues.

name: Black Dalton Wool Dinner Jacket
description:
The Favourbrook Black Dalton Wool Dinner Jacket embodies sophisticated evening refinement, perfectly suited for black-tie occasions, formal dinners, galas, or any event demanding timeless elegance with a touch of modern comfort. 

Meticulously crafted from premium virgin wool (with a subtle hint of elastane for ease of movement and all-day wearability), this single-breasted dinner jacket features impeccably proportioned silk grosgrain peak lapels that catch the light with subtle sheen, delivering classic black-tie distinction. The clean single-button closure creates a sharp, flattering line, while the two front pockets - expertly cut on the bias for a dynamic, tailored appearance -and four-button working cuffs add artisanal detail and functionality. Favourbrook's signature British tailoring ensures exceptional drape, precise fit, and heirloom-quality construction that elevates every silhouette.

name: Black Grosgrain Silk Pleated Cummerbund & Bow Tie Set
description: For those who prefer a more matte alternative to the sheen of satin, our Bow Tie and Cummerbund Set in Black Ribbed Silk is a subtle finishing touch to your formal look. Crafted in the UK, this set is a discerning accompaniment to your dinner jacket.

name: Black Duchesse Satin Silk Bow Tie
description: No sartorial accessory does more to accentuate one’s personal style than the bow tie. This Duchesse satin silk is a high thread count satin with extra weight that allows it to hold its shape, making it ideal for use in bow ties. This bow tie is an immaculately smart companion to any formal dress.
